recentItems.title: Resident Evil Requiem: The Dive Haunted House - Halloween Horror Nights Universal Studios Japan
recentItems.description:
Resident Evil: Requiem – The Dive is an R15 experience in which guests will be “relentlessly pursued by hideous creatures that will make you want to cover your eyes, with unpredictable attacks coming from the ceiling, from your feet, from all directions!”

FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft has disappeared while investigating mysterious deaths at the Wrenwood Hotel, abandoned at the outskirts of Raccoon City. Guests go in to search for her among zombies.

The story begins in the back alleys of the hotel before moving inside, where monsters attack from all angles. The climactic action features Grace and Leon S. Kennedy.
